scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Cotton]
Well, you look to weak to work. I don't think you can do it right now.
scripts.translation:
[棉花]
你看起来太虚弱了，不适合工作。我觉得你现在做不了这件事。

scripts.text: - This quest is for level 150 or higher -
scripts.translation: - 此任务需要等级150或更高 -

scripts.text: - I've met eyes with the automatic doll in front of the farming facility. -
scripts.translation: - 我看见了农业设施前的自动人偶。-

scripts.text: - The doll looked at me up and down, and turn its head. -
scripts.translation: - 人偶上下打量了我一番，然后转过了头。-

scripts.text: - I've met eyes with the automatic doll in front of the farming facility. -
scripts.translation: - 我看见了农业设施前的自动人偶。-

scripts.text:
[Automatic Doll]
Heart rate, blood pressure, and body temperature is all normal.
Breathing is normal. Eyes stability normal.
Checking registration information...
scripts.translation:
[自动人偶]
心率、血压和体温均正常。
呼吸正常。眼部稳定性正常。
正在核对注册信息...

scripts.text: - The doll looked at me up and down, and as if she look satisfied. -
scripts.translation: - 人偶上下打量了我一番，似乎很满意。-

scripts.text:
[Automatic Doll]
Hello, {0}?
Did you come to see farming facility?
scripts.translation:
[自动人偶]
你好，{0}？
你是来看农业设施的吗？

scripts.text: Huh.
scripts.translation: 哈。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Automatic Doll]
This is the farming facility, where Kitty and the others live.
Just talk to me, if you're interested.
I will explain everything to you.
scripts.translation:
[自动人偶]
这里是农业设施，小猫咪和其他伙伴就住在这里。
如果你感兴趣，尽管问我。
我会向你解释一切。

scripts.text:
[Automatic Doll]
Kitty, hold still for a minute. Good boy~
I am in charge of the farm facility here.
I fix the plants, give it fertilizer and feed kitty here and his friends.
scripts.translation:
[自动人偶]
小猫咪，站好别动。乖~
我负责这里的农业设施。
我照料植物，施肥，并喂养小猫咪和它的朋友们。

scripts.text:
[Automatic Doll]
The ingredients for the dessert that comes out from the cafeteria is harvested here.
Ehem.
scripts.translation:
[自动人偶]
食堂甜点所需的食材就是在这里收获的。
咳。

scripts.text:
[Automatic Doll]
There have been a lot of guests lately, so we've been given more orders to harvest.
My colleague from an another job has just been assigned to this place, but she's a little clumsy.
It's easy to get a good harvest when everyone listens.
scripts.translation:
[自动人偶]
最近客人很多，所以我们接到了更多的收获订单。
另一位同事刚被分配到这个地方，但她有点笨手笨脚。
只要大家配合，收获就会很顺利。

scripts.text: You're talkative.
scripts.translation: 你很健谈

scripts.text:
[Luina]
Oh, I forgot that I should introduce myself first, if I wanted to talk to a guest for a long time.
My name is Luina.
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
哎呀，我忘了，如果想和客人聊很久，应该先自我介绍。
我叫露伊娜。

scripts.text:
[Luina]
Kitty here is a plant called a Pitaya. It's an improved ancient species that lived somewhere on this island.
I don't know if it's weird, but I'm not a Pitaya, but I'm good at listening.
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
这里的小猫咪是一种叫火龙果的植物。它是岛上某个地方生活过的古老物种的改良版。
虽然有点奇怪，但我不是火龙果，不过我很擅长倾听。

scripts.text: - Luina stroked the Pitaya. -
scripts.translation: - 露伊娜抚摸着火龙果。-

scripts.text:
[Luina]
My master told me, I should name cute little things.
Kitty, Butterfly, Happy, and so on.
Pitaya is a small and cute creature, so I gave them a name.
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
师父告诉我，应该给可爱的小东西起名字。
小猫咪、蝴蝶、快乐，等等。
火龙果是又小又可爱的生物，所以我给它们起了名字。

scripts.text:
[Luina]
Kitty is the cutest, the pitaya over here is Kitty.
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
小猫咪是最可爱的，那边的火龙果就是小猫咪。

scripts.text:
[Luina]
So...
Are you here to cut off some tails?
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
那么...
你是来剪尾巴的吗？

scripts.text: Tail?
scripts.translation: 尾巴？

scripts.text: I don't have a tail.
scripts.translation: 我没有尾巴。

scripts.text:
[Luina]
You're here to cut off some tails, aren't you?
Oh, I've made a mistake.
Hold on for a while. I'll process the explanation.
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
你是来剪尾巴的，对吧？
哎呀，我搞错了。
请稍等，我去处理一下说明。

scripts.text:
[Luina]
If you look at Kitty right now, He doesn't have roots, right?
It absorbs moisture from the air and photosyntheses it even without the roots.
Just some fertilizer... and some foods.
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
现在看看小猫咪，它没有根，对吧？
它从空气中吸收水分，即使没有根也能进行光合作用。
只需要一些肥料...和一些食物。

scripts.text:
[Luina]
When you plant the seeds, they grow out of the ground, but I've never seen a multiple sprout before.
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
当你种下种子时，它们会从土里长出来，但我从未见过一次长出多株的情况。

scripts.text:
[Luina]
For the tail, You just grab the Pitaya, stroke it like this, and let them go.
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
至于尾巴，你只需要抓住火龙果，像这样抚摸它，然后放手即可。

scripts.text: - Luina held the Pitaya, demo to on how to pull the tail and put it down. -
scripts.translation: - 露伊娜抓住火龙果，演示如何拉下尾巴并放下。-

scripts.text:
[Luina]
No, no. I didn't pull it.
The harvested tail is not necessarily enough to eat.
You have to take the loss into account.
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
不，不。我没有拉它。
收获的尾巴不一定足够吃。
你必须考虑到损耗。

scripts.text:
[Luina]
You need to remove the seeds and the skin, but it's not difficult.
After processing it, the harvested Pitaya tail goes up to the table.
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
你需要去除种子和果皮，但这并不难。
处理完毕后，收获的火龙果尾巴就可以上桌了。

scripts.text:
[Luina]
Harvesting is actually a bit difficult, so my colleague, 'Silk', will guide you.
You can enter even without a harvest. I'll just let you in here without a guide.
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
收获其实有点难，所以我的同事“丝绸”会指导你。
即使没有收获也可以进入。我会直接让你进来，不需要向导。

scripts.text:
[Luina]
If you're free, talk to 'Cotton' here, she's the play manager, and she'll let you know what to do.
I know it's a little hard for you, but... if you lend us a hand, we will properly compensate you.
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
如果你有空，可以和这里的“棉花”谈谈，她是游乐管理员，她会告诉你该怎么做。
我知道这对你来说有点难，但...如果你能帮个忙，我们会好好补偿你的。

scripts.text:
[Luina]
Now that you've heard the instructions, you can enter now.
You can just go in if you want to look around.
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
既然你已经听完了说明，现在可以进去了。
如果你想四处看看，直接进去就行。

scripts.text:
[Luina]
We talked about Cotton's job first, but it's actually the harvest that's more urgent.
If you're confident in your combat skills, I'd like you to help with the harvest.
I wish you can help me with the harvest...
We have to feed Boss Kitty also.
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
我们先谈了棉花的工作，但实际上收获更紧急。
如果你对自己的战斗技能有信心，我希望你能帮忙收获。
我希望你能帮我收获...
我们还得喂老板小猫咪呢。

scripts.text: Boss Kitty?
scripts.translation: 老板小猫咪？

scripts.text:
[Luina]
I just call him that, He is a little different from the other, it's hiding in a place that's hard to see.
If you want to see him around, you'll have to sprink the food and make it a little noisy around the farm.
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
我只是这么叫它，它和其他的有点不同，它藏在一个很难看到的地方。
如果你想看到它，你得撒点食物，并在农场周围制造一点噪音。

scripts.text:
[Luina]
I'm the one in charge of the harvest, so please talk to me anytime you want!
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
我负责收获，所以请随时来找我！

scripts.text:
[Luina]
Let's talk about the details when you want to help.
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
等你想帮忙时，我们再谈细节。

scripts.text:
[Luina]
Did the younglings came to play with you?
That's strange... I heard you very well.
... what? Even Silk?
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
幼崽们来和你玩了？
这很奇怪...我听得清清楚楚。
...什么？连丝绸也是？
发生什么事了？

scripts.text: She is pretending to be a cat.
scripts.translation: 它在假装成猫。

scripts.text:
[Kitty]
Cluck.
scripts.translation:
[小猫咪]
咯咯。

scripts.text: -- The cat hid behind Luina before she reached it. --
scripts.translation: -- 猫在露伊娜抓到它之前躲到了她身后。--

scripts.text:
[Luina]
What...
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
什么...

scripts.text:
[Luina]
Maybe... just maybe?
It's listening to me?
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
也许...也许真的是这样？
它在听我说话？

scripts.text: I guess.
scripts.translation: 我想是吧。

scripts.text:
[Luina]
Kitty.
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
小猫咪。

scripts.text:
[Luina]
...
Is this what the guests would say as 'embarassed'?
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
...
这就是客人们所说的“尴尬”吗？

scripts.text: - When Luina reached out her hand to the cat, it put it's heads up to her hand. -
scripts.translation: - 当露伊娜伸出手去抚摸猫时，它抬起头蹭了蹭她的手。-

scripts.text: - Luina's face became complex with a satisfied expression while petting the cat. -
scripts.translation: - 露伊娜一边抚摸猫，脸上露出了既复杂又满足的表情。-

scripts.text:
[Luina]
Hmm...
Won't the guest will be able to befriend meow someday?
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
嗯...
总有一天，客人也能和喵成为朋友吧？

scripts.text:
[Luina]
Wouldn't it be great if we continued playing with them like this?
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
如果我们能一直这样和它们玩耍，那该多好啊。

scripts.text:
[Luina]
Yes! Please help Silk again tomorrow as well.
Then, one day... You'll be able to befriend all of the Pitayas!
Here... it's a token of promise.
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
是的！明天也请继续帮助丝绸。
那么，总有一天...你就能和所有的比塔亚成为朋友了！
这个...是约定的信物。

scripts.text:
[Luina]
Probably.
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
大概吧。

scripts.text: - The cat cried with a high pitch sound as if it's excited. -
scripts.translation: - 猫发出高亢的叫声，听起来像是兴奋极了。-

scripts.text:
[Luina]
We have completed the necessary harvest for today.
We will resume our harvest again by dawn. Come back by then.
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
今天的必要收获已经完成。
我们将在黎明时分重新开始收获。请在那之前回来。

scripts.text:
[Luina]
^0000FFOur struggle with the Pitaya seems like a long time ago.^000000
^0000FFI now have the courage again to go back into the farming facility again.^000000
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
^0000FF与火龙果的斗争似乎已经是很久以前的事了。^000000
^0000FF我现在又有勇气回到农业设施了。^000000

scripts.text: ^FF0000You must organize for atleast one person or join a party to enter.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000您必须至少组织一个人或加入队伍才能进入。^000000

scripts.text:
[Luina]
!? What happened? You have a broken tail.
I'll take care of that, please.
Thank you.... After the next harvest experience, be sure to deliver it to Silk and come out.
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
！？发生什么事了？你的尾巴断了。
请让我来处理一下。
谢谢...在下一次收获体验结束后，请务必把它交给丝绸，然后出来。

scripts.text:
[Luina]
Hello, {0}.
Are you going to enter the farming facility today?
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
你好，{0}。
你今天打算进入农场设施吗？

scripts.text: Enter the dungeon.
scripts.translation: 进入地下城

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Luina]
Please wait for a moment~
I'll prepare the food for today.
scripts.translation:
[露伊娜]
请稍等~
我去准备今天的食物。

scripts.text: ^FF0000The memorial dungeon hasn't been created yet.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000记忆地下城尚未创建。^000000

scripts.text:
[Big Meow]
Purr.
scripts.translation:
[大喵]
呼噜。

scripts.text: -- Big meow is taking a nap. --
scripts.translation: -- 大喵正在打盹。 --
